origin.description: Set the default locale used when a locale argument is null.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: One locale identifier. C becomes en_US_POSIX.

origin.details: The previous locale is returned invisibly. A message on stderr quotes the short stri_info line.
origin.value: The previously used locale name, invisibly.
origin.example: old <- stri_locale_get(); stri_locale_set("de_AT"); cat(paste0("stri_locale_set(\"de_AT\") selects ", stri_locale_get(), ".\n")); stri_locale_set(old)

translation.description: Set the default locale used when a locale argument is null.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: One locale identifier. C becomes en_US_POSIX.

translation.details: The previous locale is returned. A line on stderr quotes the short stri_info line. An empty locale is an error.
translation.example:
previous = stri_locale_get()
stri_locale_set("de_AT")
print(f"stri_locale_set('de_AT') selects {stri_locale_get()}.")
stri_locale_set(previous)
